text:
</sub>  Count findings from the precision fixture

When applying AC9's strict precision-regression test, these totals are taken from each record's top-level `falsePositives`, which belong to the recall pass over the seeded benchmark. The actual precision results are under `precisionFixtures`, and all ten records report `falsePositiveCount: 0`, `falsePositives: []`, and `clean: true`. Therefore the precision totals are 0 versus 0 and neither regression clause fires; reporting 8 versus 7 as `REGRESSED` corrupts the experiment result and can incorrectly trigger category-list revision or narrowing.
